decisions.evidence: maker r3 presents the save flow ('Paste a link... Save bookmark... appear in your list') with no duplicate handling. client r3: 'if I save a URL that's already in my collection, please take me to the existing bookmark so I can update it instead of creating a duplicate.'
decisions.note: Prototype review, save-flow stage. Presented scope omitted the re-save/dedup requirement (REF-BM-06); client requested the missing reference behaviour -> corrective/extend.

decisions.evidence: maker r3: app 'fills in a title and description for you'; 'I chose which fields you get: an auto-filled title and description, plus optional tags and a note.' Reference requires auto-collecting title, description, favicon AND preview image. client r3 accepts flow, never mentions favicon/preview image.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Presented metadata collection under-fulfils REF-BM-02 (favicon and preview image absent); difference not expressed by client -> unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: maker r3: 'The saved link shows title, address, description, your tags, and your note — I decided that layout.' Reference REF-BM-07 requires exposing title, description, tags AND favicon per item. client r3 gives no reaction to favicon absence.
decisions.note: Prototype review, list-layout decision. Favicon omitted from per-item display; not surfaced by client -> unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: maker r3: 'I assumed tags are typed as words separated by commas.' client r3: 'comma-separated tags are fine.' Reference REF-BM-10 requires offering existing tags as autocomplete on entry.
decisions.note: Prototype review. No autocomplete offered (divergence from REF-BM-10). Client accepts the comma format only; does NOT identify the autocomplete difference, so this is not an accepted_divergence ('comma tags are fine' addresses format, not the missing autocomplete) -> unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: maker r3 presents a note field ('a short note like handy JS cheatsheet') as plain text; no markdown authoring/rendering shown here or later. Reference REF-BM-23 requires a markdown note rendered on view. client never raises markdown.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Note exists but markdown rendering absent (partial divergence from REF-BM-23); difference not expressed -> unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: maker r4 delivers dedup: 'brings that existing bookmark up in the editor... Save button becomes Update bookmark' plus 'a small Edit link on every saved item.' client r4: 'that duplicate handling works the way I had in mind... The matching rules you chose also seem sensible.'
decisions.note: Prototype-review delivery of the previously-captured REF-BM-06 request and edit-any-bookmark (REF-BM-04); conforming implementation, alternative UI offered was orthogonal/equivalent -> not_divergent.

decisions.evidence: maker r5: 'One search box that looks everywhere at once — it matches against the title, description, tags, your note, and the web address.' client r5: 'One search box across everything is exactly what I want.'
decisions.note: Prototype review, search stage. Conforms to REF-BM-12 (full-text across required fields) -> not_divergent.

decisions.evidence: maker r5 presents plain-word search without addressing case handling (examples all lowercase). client r5: 'It should also ignore capitalization.'
decisions.note: Search-review stage. Case-insensitivity (REF-BM-13) absent from presented scope; client supplies the reference requirement -> corrective/extend. Confirmed delivered r6 ('capitalization is ignored everywhere').

decisions.evidence: maker r5 presents only one-box + multi-word-narrowing search. client r5: 'I'd like the same box to support more precise searches: #reference for a specific tag, quotation marks for an exact phrase, and combinations using AND, OR, NOT, and parentheses.'
decisions.note: Search-review stage. Precise-query features (#tag REF-BM-14, phrase REF-BM-16, boolean/parentheses REF-BM-15) entirely absent from presented scope; client requests these reference requirements -> corrective/extend. Delivered conforming in r6.

decisions.evidence: maker r6 offers '#tag matches the whole tag exactly... Is exact-match what you'd expect, or would you want #ref to catch reference too?' client r6: '#tag should match the whole tag exactly.'
decisions.note: Specification-detail review. Both offered alternatives are compatible with REF-BM-14's #tag syntax; exact-match conforms and client selects it. Alternatives orthogonal to the functional item -> not_divergent.

decisions.evidence: maker r7 offers read-later staying in All with a flag vs removed from All. client r7: 'A Read later bookmark should remain in All with a flag and also appear in its focused view; once I mark it as read, it should leave the Read later view.'
decisions.note: Prototype review, read-later lane. Reference (REF-BM-17/18/19) does not mandate removal from All; the chosen behaviour conforms and mark-as-read retiring the item satisfies REF-BM-19. Choice orthogonal/equivalent -> not_divergent.

decisions.evidence: maker r7: 'Archived items are hidden from All and only turn up in the Archived view — including when you search.' client r7: 'Archived bookmarks should stay out of All and normal searches, with searching available after switching to Archived.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Conforms to REF-BM-26 (archive hides from default list/search) and REF-BM-28 (separate archived list) and the archive edge-case rule -> not_divergent.

decisions.evidence: maker r9 presents archive-only state ('nothing is ever truly deleted — archiving tucks things away but you can always restore them') and offers a choice: 'Do you want a way to permanently delete a bookmark, or is archive enough for this first version?' client r9: 'I do want permanent deletion as a separate action from Archive, with a clear confirmation because it can't be undone.'
decisions.note: Specification-gate/edge-case review. Presented state lacked delete and did not distinguish delete from archive (REF-BM-05, REF-BM-27); maker offered alternatives that differ in fulfilment, client selected the reference-conforming one -> corrective/select. Delivered conforming r10.
